name: cd
description: Shell builtin that moves the working directory. Without an argument, it takes you back to your home directory ($HOME). Paths can be absolute (/etc) or relative to the current directory (../docs).

options.description: Follows symbolic links logically (the default): “..” goes back up the path as it was typed.
Uses the physical layout of the disk: symbolic links are resolved before “..” is handled.

arguments.name: DIRECTORY
arguments.description: Destination. “~” means the home directory, “..” the parent, “-” the previous directory.

examples.explanation: Goes up one level, into the parent directory.
Goes back to the home directory.
Goes back to the previous directory and prints its path.
